name: Sketchbook
tagline: Charcoal and graphite sketches on toned paper
technique: Architectural sketchbook drawing: charcoal and graphite on warm toned paper, confident loose lines, smudged shading, white chalk highlights, one red-pencil accent — the drawing of someone who builds things.

font.role: elegant serif for headlines, italic for emphasis

plates.accept: Charcoal house sketch, left third empty, red pencil accent; no text.
Interior sketch with chalk light; no text.
Floor-plan sketch with tools; no text or dimension numbers.

generate.base: A loose charcoal and graphite sketch of {subject} on warm toned sketchbook paper: confident lines, smudged shading, a few white chalk highlights, one red-pencil accent, unfinished edges. No people's faces.
generate.spot: A single loose charcoal and graphite sketch of {subject}, confident lines, smudged shading, one small red-pencil accent, drawing only.
generate.rules: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.

prompts.hero.webp: A loose charcoal and graphite architectural sketch on warm toned sketchbook paper: the facade of a modern two-storey house with a terrace and large windows, drawn in perspective in the right two thirds of the sheet, construction and perspective lines left visible, smudged charcoal shading, a few white chalk highlights on the glass, one red-pencil accent line along the terrace edge; the left third of the paper is empty. No people, no faces. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.
